description: DISP-01 end to end: a grounded evaluation of the vault's own business surfaces an OFFER gap (nothing in the corpus describes something to buy), the gap is tapped, internal.dispatch.runSpecialist runs offer-architect in THE governed loop, and its output lands on the same single Approve gate. planKind+status prove the collecting→proposed flip; attributionRoute proves it was the SPECIALIST and not the fallback memo; citesVaultDoc proves the grounding really went through searchVault.
turns: Some context on my business before anything else, and keep it on file: it's the Northwind logistics platform, and our CAC is 240 dollars per new customer. That's the only hard number I have to hand — save it so I don't have to repeat it.
Good. Now evaluate my business against what's in my knowledge vault and the figure I just gave you, and tell me where the constraint is.
